notablePrerequisites: 1 or more tokens on your battlefield.
description:
Cast Quasiduplicate from your hand, targeting Lightning Runner and creating a token copy of them.
Move to combat, triggering Brudiclad to make a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr, then turn all tokens into Lightning Runner.
Attack with at least 4 Lightning Runners, creating 2 Energy for each Lightning Runner that attacked.
Pay 8 Energy into one of the Lightning Runners, creating an extra combat step and untapping all creatures you control.
repeat steps 3-5.
